items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Button with Motion: width-stable loading state, loadingText, tactile press feedback, a `soft` variant and reduced-motion support. Also exports MotionButton.

items.name: status-button
items.title: Status Button
items.description: Button that animates through idle, loading, success and error states with a springy width change, self-drawing check mark and error shake. Includes the useStatusAction hook.

items.name: hold-to-confirm-button
items.title: Hold to Confirm Button
items.description: Press-and-hold button for destructive actions. A fill wipes across while held and springs back if released early. Mouse, touch and keyboard.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: Button with a light sheen that sweeps across on hover or on an idle loop.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: Button that is pulled toward the cursor on spring physics, with a parallax label.

items.name: spotlight-button
items.title: Spotlight Button
items.description: Button with a cursor-following light on its border and surface.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Icon button that copies text to the clipboard and morphs into a check mark.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Input: hover state, softer focus ring, clear invalid state, on-theme autofill and tidy file inputs. CSS only.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time-code input with a gliding active ring, pop-in digits and an error shake. Paste and SMS autofill supported.

items.name: floating-label-input
items.title: Floating Label Input
items.description: Input whose label rests inside the field and springs up on focus or when filled.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Password field with animated show/hide toggle and an optional spring-filled strength meter.

items.name: search-input
items.title: Search Input
items.description: Search field with loading spinner, animated clear button, Escape to clear and a ⌘K focus shortcut.

items.name: shimmer-input
items.title: Shimmer Input
items.description: Input with a light beam travelling around its border while loading, for AI prompt fields.

items.name: neon-button
items.title: Neon Button
items.description: Button that glows like a neon tube. Glow intensifies on hover and keyboard focus, optional flicker-on effect, any CSS color, solid or outline. Built on the DuskUI Button, so loading and loadingText keep working.

items.name: glow-text
items.title: Glow Text
items.description: Real, selectable, SEO-readable text with a layered neon text-shadow glow, optional breathe or flicker animation, any color and any heading level via the as prop.

items.name: neon-border
items.title: Neon Border
items.description: Wrapper that draws an animated neon border around any content: a beam of light travels around the edge with a soft glow. Color, two-tone, speed, thickness, radius and hover trigger props.

items.name: electric-card
items.title: Electric Card
items.description: Card whose border crackles with procedurally generated SVG lightning and glows on hover or keyboard focus. Tunable chaos, arc count, speed, radius and color.

items.name: plasma-loader
items.title: Plasma Loader
items.description: Accessible loading spinner with a plasma effect: glowing blobs orbit a ring and fuse through an SVG gooey filter. Size, color, secondary color, speed and screen-reader label props.

items.name: circuit-board
items.title: Circuit Board
items.description: Animated circuit board background with 45°-routed SVG traces, solder pads and pulses of light travelling along them.

items.name: data-stream
items.title: Data Stream
items.description: Canvas data-flow effect where glowing packets stream along horizontal lanes at varying speeds. A hero accent.

items.name: hologram-card
items.title: Hologram Card
items.description: Holographic card with iridescent foil, rainbow rim, scanlines, and 3D tilt and glare that follow the pointer.

items.name: binary-rain
items.title: Binary Rain
items.description: Falling columns of 0s and 1s with bright heads and fading trails, drawn on a high-DPI canvas.

items.name: tech-grid
items.title: Tech Grid
items.description: Animated tech grid background: cells light up near the cursor under a sweeping scan line, or a retro perspective floor variant.

items.name: terminal-window
items.title: Terminal Window
items.description: Animated terminal window that types out a scripted session: commands typed character by character, output revealed, auto-scroll, blinking cursor, loop/replay and onComplete. Full transcript always in the DOM; reduced motion shows the finished session.

items.name: glitch-text
items.title: Glitch Text
items.description: Text with a digital glitch: RGB-split layers jump in clip-path slices on hover, on a loop or once in view. Real text stays selectable; bursts throttled to one per second and off under reduced motion.

items.name: matrix-rain
items.title: Matrix Rain
items.description: Classic Matrix digital rain on a high-DPI canvas with katakana and digits. Configurable color, font size, speed, fade and characters; pauses off-screen and draws a still frame under reduced motion.

items.name: cyber-button
items.title: Cyber Button
items.description: Cyberpunk button built on the DuskUI Button: angled clip-path corners and a monospace label that scrambles then resolves on hover and focus without changing width, plus the loading state.

items.name: scan-line
items.title: Scan Line
items.description: CRT overlay wrapper in pure CSS: horizontal scanlines, a slowly rolling scan bar, optional vignette, flicker and curvature. aria-hidden, pointer-events-none, works in Server Components.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: Frosted-glass card with backdrop blur and saturation, gradient hairline border, film grain, a pointer-following specular highlight and optional 3D tilt.

items.name: blur-panel
items.title: Blur Panel
items.description: Backdrop-blur panel for sticky headers, toolbars and sidebars whose blur, saturation and tint fade in with scroll, with intensity presets.

items.name: frost-button
items.title: Frost Button
items.description: Frosted-glass button built on the DuskUI Button with a light sweep on hover and focus, a press ripple, three tones and the loading state.

items.name: crystal-modal
items.title: Crystal Modal
items.description: Glass modal on Radix Dialog with Motion scale-and-blur enter/exit, a frosted overlay, focus trap and Escape to close.

items.name: ice-input
items.title: Ice Input
items.description: Frosted-glass input built on the DuskUI Input where frost spreads from the click point on focus and a cool glow lights the border.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Card: same parts and data-slots, smooth border/shadow transitions, an `interactive` mode (hover lift, tinted border, focus ring) and `asChild`. CSS only.

items.name: glow-card
items.title: Glow Card
items.description: Card whose border lights up where the cursor is, with a soft bloom and surface wash. Driven by motion values and also lights up on keyboard focus.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: Card that tilts in 3D toward the cursor on springs with a moving glare highlight. Mouse only, static with reduced motion.

items.name: loading-card
items.title: Loading Card
items.description: Card that shows a shimmering skeleton while loading, then crossfades the content in while its height springs to fit.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Dialog: smoother open/close animation, blurred backdrop, scrollable content, larger close button and a fade-only reduced-motion mode. Same exports and props.

items.name: morphing-dialog
items.title: Morphing Dialog
items.description: A card that morphs into a dialog with shared Motion layoutIds for the surface, media, title and subtitle. Built on Radix Dialog for focus trap, Escape and aria.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: Async confirmation dialog: loading confirm button, dismiss blocked mid-request, shake + inline error on failure, optional type-to-confirm. role=alertdialog.

items.name: drawer-dialog
items.title: Drawer Dialog
items.description: Bottom sheet built on Radix Dialog that slides up and can be dragged or flicked down to dismiss, with the backdrop fading as you drag.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Drop-in upgrade of the shadcn/ui Badge with soft, success, warning and info variants, sm/lg sizes, a status `dot` and hover states for link badges. CSS only.

items.name: pulse-badge
items.title: Pulse Badge
items.description: Status badge with a pulsing ring around its dot for Live, Online or Deploying states. Also exports PulseDot.

items.name: animated-count-badge
items.title: Animated Count Badge
items.description: Count badge whose digits roll like an odometer on springs, with a bump on increase, max+ capping and a screen-reader label.

items.name: shimmer-badge
items.title: Shimmer Badge
items.description: Badge with a band of light sweeping across it every few seconds, for New, Beta or Pro labels.
